newlib (as shipped in the retail newlib), whose stdio/stdlib the retail
conversions src/platform/ee_printf.c, ee_scanf.c, ee_strtod.c, ee_dtoa.c and
ee_decimal.c adapt. The Berkeley text below is verbatim from ee_printf.c; the
AT&T text is verbatim from ee_dtoa.c:
